now fix the current flow of the web application, fir do the changes in the backend and then in frontend, correct flow order wise. - admins add products, manage clients/vendors/shelf locations / products / bag quantities /grades. etc - qc person will create batches -> automatically qc passed ( no failed qc batches will be recorded ) - dispatch person can be able to see the qc passed batches, and request dispatch order - qc person will approve dispatch order . - dispatch person will see approved dispatch orders and can able to download the packaging list after the approval. - dispatch person will scan each product and start loading. - while loading live preview will be shown to the admins ( for example 10/100 products/bags loaded) - dispatch person will need to enter a seal number at the end. and then mark that batch is dispatched or not. the following is the detailed SRS document, you should review it once. # Software Requirements Specification (SRS) ## Product Scanning & Dispatch Workflow System | | | |---|---| | **Project** | ProductScanning — QC → Dispatch workflow | | **Doc version** | 2.0 | | **Date** | 29 Oct 2026 | | **Status** | Approved for implementation | | **Audience** | Any human developer, QA, BA — **or any AI agent** given this document plus the repository | --- ## 0. How to read / use this document (for implementers and AI agents) This is a **self-contained, normative specification**. If you are implementing from this document: 1. **Sections marked MUST / MUST NOT / SHOULD** are binding requirements. Everything else is context. 2. §1–§5 define *what* to build (behaviour, rules, acceptance criteria). §6 defines *data shapes* (MongoDB + SQL, both provided; production uses **only one**, see §6.4). §6.5 defines *API contracts* verbatim — implement routes exactly as specified. 3. The existing codebase consistent with this document: `backend/` (Node.js + Express + TypeScript, JWT auth, role middleware), `frontend/` (React + Vite web app), `mobile/` + `mobile2/` (Expo apps for QC/DISPATCH scanning). Reuse existing patterns (controllers, mongo/mysql adapter files, sync service with `client_operation_id` idempotency, activity logging). 4. **Where this document conflicts with existing code, this document wins.** Known intentional conflicts are listed in §2.2 (behaviour changes) — the old QC pass/fail screen, admin dispatch-order approval, and dual-DB runtime mode are retired. 5. Acceptance criteria under each requirement (§5) are the definition of done. Implement all of them. --- ## 1. Introduction ### 1.1 Purpose Specify the target end-to-end workflow of the ProductScanning system: > **Admin adds products → QC creates batches (automatically QC-passed, no failed QC batches ever recorded) → Dispatch views batches and requests a dispatch order → QC approves the dispatch order → Dispatch downloads the packing list → Dispatch scans and loads the truck with a live loading preview visible to Admins (e.g. 10/100) → Dispatch enters a seal number and marks the batch DISPATCHED or NOT DISPATCHED.** ### 1.2 Scope **In scope:** product master data; QC batch creation with auto-pass; dispatch order raise; QC approval; packing-list download; scan-based loading with live admin monitoring; seal number + final dispatched/not-dispatched marking; the data model and API for all of the above. **Out of scope:** invoicing/GST billing, transportation/goods management beyond vehicle/driver/container fields, client-facing portal, accounting integrations. ### 1.3 Definitions | Term | Meaning | |---|---| | **Batch** | A production lot of one product. Holds quantity, UoM, dates, shelf location, vendor, grade, bag quantity, and a unique `barcode_value`. | | **QR label** | One printed sticker per unit/pack inside a batch (`qr_print_jobs` → `qr_labels`, unique `qr_value`). Scanned during loading. | | **Dispatch order** | A request raised by DISPATCH for one batch: client, driver name, vehicle number, container number. | | **Packing list** | Auto-generated, frozen line items for an approved dispatch order (product, batch, quantity, UoM, shelf location). | | **Loading session** | A scan-driven loading run for one approved dispatch order. Tracks `scanned` vs `total` and drives the Admin live preview. | | **Seal number** | Tamper-evidence number that DISPATCH must enter when finishing loading. | | **UoM** | Unit of measure (kg, bags, litres, …). | | **Roles** | `ADMIN`, `QC`, `DISPATCH` (JWT `role` claim; three user tables: `admins`, `qc_users`, `dispatch_users`). | ### 1.4 Normative language - **MUST / MUST NOT** — mandatory; a build that violates it is non-conforming. - **SHOULD** — strongly recommended; deviation must be justified in code comments. - **MAY** — optional. --- ## 2. Overall Description ### 2.1 Current system context (what exists today) - **Backend** (`backend/`): Express + TypeScript, port 3001, JWT access + refresh, `authenticate` + `authorize(role)` middleware, three role-specific user tables, offline-first sync service (`sync_operations`, idempotent via `client_operation_id`), activity logs, device registration, helmet/CORS/compression/rate-limiting, QR label printing pipeline (`qc/qr-jobs`), packing lists, reports/dashboards. Controller files exist in Mongo and MySQL variants (e.g. `batchController.mongo.ts` / `batchController.mysql.ts`) selected by DB config. - **Web frontend** (`frontend/`): pages for Masters, Products, Clients, Vendors, Users, Batches, QC Dashboard/Scan, Dispatch Dashboard/Orders/Scan, PackingList, Reports, Dashboard. - **Mobile** (`mobile/`, `mobile2/`): Expo apps with scanner-driven screens (batches, dispatch orders, scan tab) and offline sync support. - **Existing flow (to be replaced):** production creates batches in `CREATED`; QC scans and records PASS or FAIL (failed batches recorded, reopenable); dispatch orders approved by ADMIN *or* QC; no loading sessions, no live preview, no seal number. ### 2.2 Intentional behaviour changes vs current code | # | Current | Target (this SRS) | |---|---|---| | 1 | Admin manages products/master data | **Unchanged** (FR-01, FR-02) | | 2 | Batch created in `CREATED`; QC later records PASS/FAIL; failed QC batches exist and can be reopened | **QC creates the batch directly in `QC_PASSED`.** The system MUST NOT record failed QC batches anywhere. An `AUTO_PASS` QC record is written for audit only. Endpoints for manual FAIL submit, bulk FAIL submit, and reopen-failed-batch are **removed**. | | 3 | Dispatch order approved by ADMIN or QC | Approval/rejection is a **QC-only** action. Admin has read-only visibility of orders. | | 4 | Packing list viewable on a web page | Dispatch MUST be able to **download** the packing list (PDF/print-ready) for approved orders. | | 5 | Dispatch confirms dispatch per scan; no load tracking | Dispatch **starts a Loading Session**, scans unit QR codes with a live `scanned/total` counter, and Admin sees a **live preview** of every active session (e.g. **10/100**). | | 6 | No seal number, no explicit "not dispatched" outcome | Dispatch **MUST** enter a **seal number** and mark the outcome **DISPATCHED** or **NOT DISPATCHED** (with remarks) to close the session; this updates order, batch, and dispatch-record state. | | 7 | Backend runs in dual DB mode (MySQL or Mongo adapters) | **Single-database mode.** One of MongoDB or MySQL is chosen as the *only* datastore; the other adapter code path is retired. Schema design for both is provided in §6. | ### 2.3 User classes | Role | Platforms | Capability summary | |---|---|---| | ADMIN | Web (+ mobile) | Products & masters, users, live loading monitor, reports/audit. **No order approval.** | | QC | Mobile + web | Create auto-passed batches, print/reprint QR labels, approve/reject dispatch orders. | | DISPATCH | Mobile + web | View QC-passed batches, raise dispatch orders, download packing lists, scan-load with counter, seal & finalise. | --- ## 3. Role Responsibilities (Deliverable 1) ### 3.1 ADMIN — "gatekeeper of master data and all-seeing monitor" 1. **Products:** add/edit/disable products with: name, description, SKU, price, quantity, CAS number, molecular formula, purity, grade, storage conditions, hazard classification, physical state, HSN code, manufacturer. 2. **Masters:** manage clients, vendors, grades, bag quantities, shelf locations (all with active/inactive flags). Grades and bag quantities feed QC's batch-creation dropdowns. 3. **Users:** create/administer QC and DISPATCH accounts (type = `admins` | `qc` | `dispatch`), activate/deactivate, reset passwords. 4. **Monitoring:** - All batches and current inventory state (read). - All dispatch orders and their statuses (read-only — MUST NOT approve/reject). - **Live loading preview:** every active loading session with `scanned/total` (e.g. **10/100**), % progress, last scan event + timestamp, duplicate/wrong-batch warnings; refresh latency ≤ 3 s (polling) or near-real-time (SSE). - Completed sessions: seal number, outcome (DISPATCHED / NOT DISPATCHED), remarks. 5. **Reports & audit:** dashboards, activity logs, QC history (PASS-only), dispatch history. ### 3.2 QC — "creator of good batches and approver of orders" 1. **Batch creation (auto-pass):** create batches against Admin-defined products. The batch MUST be created with status **`QC_PASSED`** and the system MUST simultaneously write one QC audit record (`result = PASS`, `method = AUTO_PASS`, tester = creating QC user). The system MUST NOT provide any UI or API to record a QC FAIL. If material is bad, QC simply does not create the batch (or deactivates/edits it before dispatch) — no failed-QC trace is retained. 2. **Labels:** generate QR print jobs per batch (quantity of unit labels), print and reprint labels. 3. **Batch upkeep:** edit batch details, finish-goods completion, assign shelf location, deactivate. 4. **Dispatch order approval:** review the PENDING queue of dispatch orders; each decision is **Approve** (order → `APPROVED`, batch → `DISPATCH_APPROVED`, packing list frozen) or **Reject** (order → `REJECTED` with remarks, batch returns to `QC_PASSED`). 5. Optionally view QC statistics. ### 3.3 DISPATCH — "hands that move the goods" 1. **View batches:** list of batches with status `QC_PASSED` / `DISPATCH_ORDER_RAISED` (product, quantity, UoM, shelf location). 2. **Raise dispatch order:** pick a batch + client, enter driver name, vehicle number, container number → order `PENDING`; batch → `DISPATCH_ORDER_RAISED`. 3. **Track own orders:** `/mine` list with status (`PENDING`/`APPROVED`/`REJECTED`) and QC remarks. 4. **Download packing list:** for approved orders download/print PDF (client, driver, vehicle, product, batch number, quantity, UoM, shelf location). 5. **Load by scan:** start a Loading Session on an approved order (`total` = order/batch quantity); scan each unit's QR (`scanned` increments); duplicates warned, foreign-batch scans flagged; every scan recorded as an event. 6. **Seal & finalise:** when done enter a non-empty **seal number**, mark the outcome **DISPATCHED** or **NOT DISPATCHED** (+ optional remarks). Session closes; order and batch reach their final status. --- ## 4. Flow (Deliverable 2) ### 4.1 Flow narrative with arrows ``` ADMIN │ adds products (SKU, grade, HSN, hazard, price…) │ maintains clients / vendors / grades / bag quantities / shelf locations / users ▼ Products available as master data ─────────────────────────┐ │ QC │ │ selects product → creates BATCH │ │ (status = QC_PASSED automatically; AUTO_PASS audit row; │ │ NO failed-QC batches are ever recorded) │ │ generates & prints QR labels for the batch │ ▼ │ Batches visible (QC_PASSED) ◄─────────────────────────────────┘ │ DISPATCH │ browses QC_PASSED batches │ picks batch + client + driver + vehicle (+ container) │ ──► raises DISPATCH ORDER (status = PENDING) ▼ QC │ reviews PENDING dispatch orders │ ├── Approve ──► order = APPROVED, batch = DISPATCH_APPROVED, │ │ packing list frozen │ └── Reject ──► order = REJECTED (+ remarks), batch stays QC_PASSED ▼ DISPATCH │ sees APPROVED orders │ downloads / prints PACKING LIST │ starts LOADING SESSION (total = order/batch quantity) │ scans unit QR codes one by one │ scanned count increments ; duplicates & wrong-batch flagged ▼ ADMIN (live, read-only) │ watches loading preview [ scanned / total e.g. 10/100 ] │ progress bar + last-scan feed ▼ DISPATCH │ when all units scanned (or shortfall decided) │ enters SEAL NUMBER (required) │ marks order/batch ──► DISPATCHED or NOT DISPATCHED (+ remarks) ▼ Session closed → batch status final → appears in Admin reports/audit ``` ### 4.2 Flow diagram (Mermaid — renders on GitHub) ```mermaid flowchart TD %% ============ ADMIN LANE ============ subgraph ADMIN["Admin (Web)"] direction TB A_Products["Add / maintain Products

(with remarks)"] D_View --> D_Raise --> D_Wait D_Approved --> D_PDF --> D_Load --> D_Seal --> D_Mark D_Mark -- Yes --> D_Done D_Mark -- No --> D_NotDone end %% ============ CROSS-LANE ============ D_Wait -.->|"PENDING order for review"| Q_Approve Q_Approve -- "Approve" --> D_Approved Q_Approve -- "Reject (remarks)" --> D_Wait D_Load -.->|"live scan events (SSE / polling)"| A_Live D_Done -.->|"status feed"| A_Reports D_NotDone -.->|"status feed"| A_Reports Q_QR -.->|"QC_PASSED batches visible"| D_View ``` ### 4.3 State machines (normative) **Batch status** ``` QC_PASSED ──(dispatch order raised)────────► DISPATCH_ORDER_RAISED ──(QC approves)────────────────► DISPATCH_APPROVED ──(loading session started)────► LOADING ──(finalised, outcome=DISPATCHED)──────► DISPATCHED [terminal] ──(finalised, outcome=NOT_DISPATCHED)─► NOT_DISPATCHED [terminal] ``` Removed legacy states: `CREATED`, `QC_FAILED`, `DISPATCH_REJECTED`. **Dispatch order status** ``` PENDING ──(QC approve)──► APPROVED ──(session finalised w/ outcome=DISPATCHED)───► CLOSED_DISPATCHED └──(session finalised w/ outcome=NOT_DISPATCHED)──► CLOSED_NOT_DISPATCHED PENDING ──(QC reject with remarks)──► REJECTED [terminal] ``` **Loading session status** ``` ACTIVE ──(finalise with seal_number + outcome)──► CLOSED [terminal] ``` A session MUST NOT be re-opened after `CLOSED`. --- ## 5. Functional Requirements, Business Rules & Acceptance Criteria ### 5.1 Products & masters (ADMIN) **FR-01 Products** - Admin MUST be able to create/edit/disable products with all fields listed in §3.1(1). SKU is unique. Non-admin roles have read/search only. - *Accept:* Admin POST `/api/products` returns 201 with saved product; DISPATCH/QC can GET but PUT/DELETE → 403. **FR-02 Masters & users** - Admin manages clients, vendors, grades, bag quantities, shelf locations (active/inactive), and QC/DISPATCH users. Existing `/api/masters`, `/api/clients`, `/api/vendors`, `/api/users`, `/api/shelf-locations` routes remain. - *Accept:* All CRUD flows still work after refactor; inactive masters never appear in QC/DISPATCH dropdowns. ### 5.2 Batch creation auto-pass (QC) **FR-03 Batch auto-pass (core change)** - `POST /api/batches` MUST be authorized to **QC** (already is) and MUST: 1. create the batch with `status = 'QC_PASSED'` (never `CREATED`), 2. write one `qc_records` row: `result='PASS'`, `method='AUTO_PASS'`, `tester_id = `, 3. write an activity log `BATCH_CREATED` (auto-passed). - The system MUST NOT expose any endpoint or UI to record `QC_FAILED`. Retired endpoints: `POST /api/qc`, `POST /api/qc/bulk`, `POST /api/qc/batches/:id/reopen`. - Batch fields: product_id (required), quantity (required > 0), uom, unit_price, manufacturing_date, expiry_date, storage/shelf location, vendor, grade, bag_quantity, notes → batch_number generated per existing `batchNumbers` util; `barcode_value` unique. - *Accept:* - QC creates batch → `GET /api/batches/:id` shows `status: 'QC_PASSED'`; `GET /api/qc/records?batch_id=` shows one `PASS`/`AUTO_PASS` row. - `POST /api/qc` (old submit) → 404/410. - DISPATCH user POST `/api/batches` → 403. - Duplicate `barcode_value` → 409. - No row anywhere contains result `FAIL` (DB constraint: `result ENUM('PASS')` / enum restricted). **FR-04 Labels** - QC creates QR print jobs (`POST /api/qc/qr-jobs`) generating `qr_labels` rows (unique `qr_value`, serial_no per job); list/get/reprint endpoints unchanged. - *Accept:* job with quantity 100 produces 100 label rows; reprint increments print_count; label values unique across the database. ### 5.3 Dispatch orders (DISPATCH raises, QC approves) **FR-05 Batch visibility for DISPATCH** - DISPATCH MUST be able to list batches filtered by `status IN ('QC_PASSED','DISPATCH_ORDER_RAISED')` with product metadata. - *Accept:* batches in `LOADING`/`DISPATCHED`/`NOT_DISPATCHED` never appear in this list. **FR-06 Raise dispatch order** - `POST /api/dispatch-orders` (DISPATCH) with either `batch_id` or `barcode_value` + `client_id`, `driver_name`, `vehicle_number`, `container_number` → creates order `PENDING`, sets batch `DISPATCH_ORDER_RAISED`. - Idempotent via `client_operation_id` (duplicate → 200 + `duplicate:true`, no second order). - *Accept:* order appears in QC's pending queue; batch status changed; retrying the same `client_operation_id` does not create a second order. - *Errors:* batch not in `QC_PASSED`/`DISPATCH_ORDER_RAISED` → 409 `code:'INVALID_BATCH_STATE'`; already has an open order → 409 `code:'OPEN_ORDER_EXISTS'`; unknown barcode → 404. **FR-07 QC approval (core change)** - `POST /api/dispatch-orders/:id/approve` and `.../reject` MUST be `authorize('QC')` **only**. - Approve → order `APPROVED`, `approved_by_id` = QC user, `approved_at` set; batch → `DISPATCH_APPROVED`; packing-list items frozen (snapshot of product/batch/quantity/UoM/location at approval time). - Reject → order `REJECTED` + required `remarks`; batch → back to `QC_PASSED`; if another order is later raised, it repeats the cycle. - *Accept:* ADMIN calling `/approve` → 403; QC approve on non-PENDING order → 409; approved order immediately downloadable (FR-08) with frozen values (later batch edits do not alter the packing list snapshot). **FR-08 Packing list download** - `GET /api/dispatch-orders/:id/packing-list` returns JSON (existing behaviour, now additionally `QC` allowed) and `GET /api/dispatch-orders/:id/packing-list.pdf` returns a print-ready PDF generated server-side — accessible to **QC and DISPATCH** (and ADMIN). - *Accept:* DISPATCH downloads the PDF for an APPROVED order and it contains client, driver, vehicle, container, product, batch number, quantity, UoM, shelf location, frozen at approval. ### 5.4 Loading & live preview (DISPATCH scans, ADMIN watches) **FR-09 Start loading session** - `POST /api/loading-sessions` (DISPATCH, or ADMIN on behalf) `{ dispatch_order_id }` → validates order is `APPROVED`, creates session `ACTIVE` with `total = order/batch quantity` and `scanned = 0`; batch → `LOADING`. - Constraint: **one ACTIVE session per order** and, at any time, one ACTIVE session per batch (409 `SESSION_EXISTS` otherwise). **FR-10 Scan** - `POST /api/loading-sessions/:id/scan` `{ qr_value, client_operation_id }` → resolves the label: - resolves to the session's batch and is first scan of that label → `result:'OK'`, `scanned += 1`; - already scanned in this session → `result:'DUPLICATE'`, counter unchanged; - label belongs to another batch (or unresolvable) → `result:'WRONG_BATCH'`, counter unchanged; - counter MUST NOT exceed `total` (extra OK scans past total → `DUPLICATE`/409 `QTY_EXCEEDED` per choice noted in §6.5). - Every scan appends a `loading_scan_events` row (idempotent on `client_operation_id`). - *Accept:* scanning 10 distinct labels of the right batch on a 100-unit order → `GET /api/loading-sessions/:id` shows `scanned: 10, total: 100`; re-scan → `DUPLICATE`, still 10; foreign label → `WRONG_BATCH`, still 10. **FR-11 Admin live preview (core change)** - `GET /api/loading-sessions/active` (ADMIN — also useful for DISPATCH Supervisor, MAY allow `ADMIN, QC`) returns every ACTIVE session: `{ session_id, order_id, batch, product, loader_name, scanned, total, updated_at, last_event }`. - Readers MUST see changes ≤ 3 s after a scan (2 s polling acceptable; `GET /api/loading-sessions/active/stream` MAY provide SSE with event IDs). - *Accept (the 10/100 demo):* DISPATCH scans 10 units; Admin's monitor page shows `10/100` for that session within 3 s. ### 5.5 Seal & finalise (DISPATCH) **FR-12 Finalise with seal + outcome (core change)** - `POST /api/loading-sessions/:id/finalise` `{ seal_number (required non-empty), outcome: 'DISPATCHED' | 'NOT_DISPATCHED', remarks? }`: 1. session → `CLOSED` with `seal_number`, `outcome`, `completed_at`; 2. order → `CLOSED_DISPATCHED` / `CLOSED_NOT_DISPATCHED`, `seal_number` stored, `dispatched_at` set if DISPATCHED; 3. batch → `DISPATCHED` / `NOT_DISPATCHED`; 4. a `dispatch_records` row written with explicit `dispatched: 1|0`; 5. activity log entries for both seal and outcome. - Finalise with `scanned < total` MUST be allowed but SHOULD require remarks (shortfall explanation); outcome `DISPATCHED` with shortfall SHOULD be flagged as an anomaly in the activity log. - Empty `seal_number` → 400; wrong role → 403; non-ACTIVE session → 409; sequence after close is immutable. - *Accept:* finalise with `outcome:'NOT_DISPATCHED'` → batch shows `NOT_DISPATCHED`; report/dashboard counts update; Admin sees seal number on the completed session. **FR-13 Offline-first & idempotency** - All mobile-scanned writes carry `client_operation_id`; duplicate replays MUST return the original result (`DUPLICATE` status, not an error). Retried orders/scans must never double-increment counters. - *Accept:* replaying the same scan operation twice keeps `scanned` unchanged and returns the first event. **FR-14 Audit trail** - Product edits, batch creation, order raise/approve/reject, session start/finalise, and notable anomalies MUST appear in `activity_logs` with user id/name/role/action/timestamp. ### 5.6 Business rules summary (BR) | BR-ID | Rule | |---|---| | BR-1 | Batch is born `QC_PASSED`; `QC_FAILED` must not exist in the system. | | BR-2 | Only QC approves/rejects dispatch orders. Admin is read-only on orders. | | BR-3 | A batch has at most one open (non-terminal) dispatch order. | | BR-4 | Loading requires an APPROVED order; one ACTIVE session per order (and per batch). | | BR-5 | `scanned` never exceeds `total`; non-OK scans do not increment. | | BR-6 | A session cannot close without a non-empty seal number. | | BR-7 | Outcome is binary: `DISPATCHED` or `NOT_DISPATCHED`; both order and batch reflect it. | | BR-8 | Packing lists are an immutable snapshot taken at approval time. | | BR-9 | All state transitions are role-guarded and logged. | | BR-10 | Every write endpoint is idempotent for mobile clients via `client_operation_id`. | ### 5.7 Non-functional requirements | ID | Requirement | |---|---| | NFR-1 | Security: JWT access+refresh unchanged; helmet, CORS whitelist, rate limits unchanged; all new endpoints role-guarded. | | NFR-2 | Live preview latency ≤ 3 s (poll) / ≤ 1 s (SSE); monitor page handles ≥ 20 concurrent ACTIVE sessions without degradation. | | NFR-3 | Offline-tolerant mobile usage: scans and finalisation queued locally, replayed via sync; conflicts surface as `CONFLICT` with clear codes. | | NFR-4 | All timestamps stored in UTC (ISO-8601 / DATETIME(3)); display localised client-side. | | NFR-5 | Single-database runtime: no dual-mode switch; remove the unused adapter path. | | NFR-6 | Backwards-compatibility helpers: `dispatch_records.dispatched` and `batches.status` mirroring keep existing dashboards functional. | --- ## 6. Database & API Design (Deliverable 3) ### 6.1 Shared logical model Entities: `users (admins, qc_users, dispatch_users)`, `products`, `batches`, `qc_records`, `qr_print_jobs`, `qr_labels`, `clients`, `vendors`, `grades`, `bag_quantities`, `shelf_locations`, `dispatch_orders`, `packing_list_items`, **`loading_sessions` (NEW)**, **`loading_scan_events` (NEW)**, `dispatch_records`, `activity_logs`, `refresh_tokens`, `devices`, `sync_operations`. New for this SRS: `batches.status` enum change (§4.3), `qc_records.method='AUTO_PASS'`, `dispatch_records.dispatched`, and the two NEW loading entities providing the live preview data. ### 6.2 MongoDB design (option A) ```js // ---------- products (unchanged, Admin-managed) ---------- products { _id, id, sku (unique), name, description, price, quantity, cas_number, molecular_formula, purity, grade, storage_conditions, hazard_classification, physical_state, hsn_code, manufacturer, created_at, updated_at } // ---------- batches ---------- batches { _id, id, product_id, batch_number, quantity, uom, unit_price, manufacturing_date, expiry_date, storage_location, shelf_location_id, vendor_id, grade_id, bag_quantity_id, batch_group_id, notes, status: "QC_PASSED"|"DISPATCH_ORDER_RAISED"|"DISPATCH_APPROVED" |"LOADING"|"DISPATCHED"|"NOT_DISPATCHED", barcode_value (unique), created_by_id, created_by_role:"QC", created_at, updated_at } // indexes: (barcode_value unique), (batch_number), (product_id, created_at -1), // (status, updated_at), (updated_at), (shelf_location_id), (batch_group_id) // ---------- qc_records (auto-pass audit only) ---------- qc_records { _id, id, batch_id, tester_id, result:"PASS", method:"AUTO_PASS", remarks, images[], client_operation_id (sparse unique), client_created_at, device_uuid, group_operation_id, created_at, updated_at } // indexes: (client_operation_id sparse unique), (batch_id, created_at -1), // (tester_id, created_at -1), (result), (created_at -1) // ---------- qr_print_jobs / qr_labels (unchanged) ---------- qr_print_jobs { _id, id, job_code (unique), product_id, quantity, created_by, created_by_role:"QC", created_at, updated_at } qr_labels { _id, id, print_job_id, batch_id, qr_value (unique), serial_no, print_count, last_printed_at, created_at } // indexes: (print_job_id, serial_no unique), (batch_id) // ---------- clients (unchanged) ---------- clients { _id, id, name, contact_person, email, phone, address, gst_number, is_active, created_at, updated_at } // ---------- dispatch_orders (QC approves) ---------- dispatch_orders { _id, id, batch_id, raised_by, status: "PENDING"|"APPROVED"|"REJECTED"|"CLOSED_DISPATCHED"|"CLOSED_NOT_DISPATCHED", client_id, driver_name, vehicle_number, container_number, approved_by_role:"QC", approved_by_id, approved_at, remarks, } → 201 { session:{ id, status:'ACTIVE', total, scanned:0 } } 409 orders must be APPROVED / SESSION_EXISTS POST /api/loading-sessions/:id/scan DISPATCH(, ADMIN) { qr_value, client_operation_id } → 200 { result:'OK'|'DUPLICATE'|'WRONG_BATCH', scanned, total, event_id, duplicate:bool } 409 QTY_EXCEEDED when OK-scan would exceed total 409 session not ACTIVE GET /api/loading-sessions/:id owner(LOADER), QC, ADMIN → { session, events:[last 50] } GET /api/loading-sessions/active ADMIN(, QC) → [ { id, order_id, batch_number, product_name, loader_name, scanned, total, updated_at, last_event:{ result, qr_value, scanned_at } } ] GET /api/loading-sessions/active/stream ADMIN SSE (MAY relocate to polling) POST /api/loading-sessions/:id/finalise DISPATCH(, ADMIN) { seal_number (required), outcome:'DISPATCHED'|'NOT_DISPATCHED', remarks?, client_operation_id? } → 200 { session(CLOSED), order_status, batch_status, dispatch_record_id } 400 missing seal_number; 409 not ACTIVE/already closed -- Sync (FR-13) ------------------------------------------------------ POST /api/sync/push adds operation types: LOADING_SESSION_START | LOADING_SESSION_SCAN | LOADING_SESSION_FINALISE GET /api/sync/pull includes loading_sessions + events cursors ``` **Frontend touchpoints** (for whoever builds the UI): - `DispatchOrders.tsx`: remove admin approve action → read-only for ADMIN. - QC gains an Approve/Reject worklist (PENDING queue + remarks dialog). - New admin page **LoadingMonitor**: polls `/loading-sessions/active` every 2 s (or SSE), renders `scanned/total` progress per session — the "10/100" view. - `DispatchScan.tsx` / mobile scan tab: start-session → scan (with OK/DUPLICATE/WRONG_BATCH feedback) → finalise sheet (seal number + DISPATCHED/NOT DISPATCHED + remarks). - QC batch-creation screen becomes the entry point for batches; old QC pass/fail screen removed. ### 6.6 Sync operation payloads (mobile offline replay) ```ts type SyncOperationType = | 'BATCH_CREATE_AUTO_PASS' | 'DISPATCH_ORDER_RAISE' | 'QC_ORDER_APPROVE' | 'QC_ORDER_REJECT' | 'LOADING_SESSION_START' | 'LOADING_SESSION_SCAN' | 'LOADING_SESSION_FINALISE'; ``` Each payload mirrors its REST body (§6.5); the server resolves `barcode_value`→`batch_id`, validates state, applies idempotently, and records the operation in `sync_operations` with statuses `APPLIED | DUPLICATE | CONFLICT | FAILED` (unchanged semantics). --- ## 7. Migration & cutover checklist 1. Choose the datastore (§6.4); retire the unused adapter code path. 2. Data migration: legacy `CREATED` batches → archive or promote to `QC_PASSED` (with AUTO_PASS record); `QC_FAILED` → `NOT_DISPATCHED` (archived, invisible to dispatch lists); `DISPATCH_REJECTED` → `QC_PASSED`. 3. Backfill `qc_records.method='AUTO_PASS'` where missing. 4. Create `loading_sessions` + `loading_scan_events` (Mongo collections or SQL tables + indexes) and the partial/generated unique constraints (BR-3, BR-4). 5. Deploy backend changes first (QC-only approval; new loading module; retire fail/reopen endpoints), then web, then mobile. 6. Optional feature flag `QC_AUTO_PASS_ENABLED` during the transition window; disable the legacy QC fail screen after go-live. --- *End of SRS — v2.0. This document alone (with the repository) is sufficient to implement the system as specified.*

now fix the current flow of the web application, fir do the changes in the backend and then in frontend, correct flow order wise. - admins add products, manage clients/vendors/shelf locations / products / bag quantities /grades. etc - qc person will create batches -> automatically qc passed ( no failed qc batches will be recorded ) - dispatch person can be able to see the qc passed batches, and request dispatch order - qc person will approve dispatch order . - dispatch person will see approved dispatch orders and can able to download the packaging list after the approval. - dispatch person will scan each product and start loading. - while loading live preview will be shown to the admins ( for example 10/100 products/bags loaded) - dispatch person will need to enter a seal number at the end. and then mark that batch is dispatched or not. the following is the detailed SRS document, you should review it once. # Software Requirements Specification (SRS) ## Product Scanning & Dispatch Workflow System | | | |---|---| | **Project** | ProductScanning — QC → Dispatch workflow | | **Doc version** | 2.0 | | **Date** | 29 Oct 2026 | | **Status** | Approved for implementation | | **Audience** | Any human developer, QA, BA — **or any AI agent** given this document plus the repository | --- ## 0. How to read / use this document (for implementers and AI agents) This is a **self-contained, normative specification**. If you are implementing from this document: 1. **Sections marked MUST / MUST NOT / SHOULD** are binding requirements. Everything else is context. 2. §1–§5 define *what* to build (behaviour, rules, acceptance criteria). §6 defines *data shapes* (MongoDB + SQL, both provided; production uses **only one**, see §6.4). §6.5 defines *API contracts* verbatim — implement routes exactly as specified. 3. The existing codebase consistent with this document: `backend/` (Node.js + Express + TypeScript, JWT auth, role middleware), `frontend/` (React + Vite web app), `mobile/` + `mobile2/` (Expo apps for QC/DISPATCH scanning). Reuse existing patterns (controllers, mongo/mysql adapter files, sync service with `client_operation_id` idempotency, activity logging). 4. **Where this document conflicts with existing code, this document wins.** Known intentional conflicts are listed in §2.2 (behaviour changes) — the old QC pass/fail screen, admin dispatch-order approval, and dual-DB runtime mode are retired. 5. Acceptance criteria under each requirement (§5) are the definition of done. Implement all of them. --- ## 1. Introduction ### 1.1 Purpose Specify the target end-to-end workflow of the ProductScanning system: > **Admin adds products → QC creates batches (automatically QC-passed, no failed QC batches ever recorded) → Dispatch views batches and requests a dispatch order → QC approves the dispatch order → Dispatch downloads the packing list → Dispatch scans and loads the truck with a live loading preview visible to Admins (e.g. 10/100) → Dispatch enters a seal number and marks the batch DISPATCHED or NOT DISPATCHED.** ### 1.2 Scope **In scope:** product master data; QC batch creation with auto-pass; dispatch order raise; QC approval; packing-list download; scan-based loading with live admin monitoring; seal number + final dispatched/not-dispatched marking; the data model and API for all of the above. **Out of scope:** invoicing/GST billing, transportation/goods management beyond vehicle/driver/container fields, client-facing portal, accounting integrations. ### 1.3 Definitions | Term | Meaning | |---|---| | **Batch** | A production lot of one product. Holds quantity, UoM, dates, shelf location, vendor, grade, bag quantity, and a unique `barcode_value`. | | **QR label** | One printed sticker per unit/pack inside a batch (`qr_print_jobs` → `qr_labels`, unique `qr_value`). Scanned during loading. | | **Dispatch order** | A request raised by DISPATCH for one batch: client, driver name, vehicle number, container number. | | **Packing list** | Auto-generated, frozen line items for an approved dispatch order (product, batch, quantity, UoM, shelf location). | | **Loading session** | A scan-driven loading run for one approved dispatch order. Tracks `scanned` vs `total` and drives the Admin live preview. | | **Seal number** | Tamper-evidence number that DISPATCH must enter when finishing loading. | | **UoM** | Unit of measure (kg, bags, litres, …). | | **Roles** | `ADMIN`, `QC`, `DISPATCH` (JWT `role` claim; three user tables: `admins`, `qc_users`, `dispatch_users`). | ### 1.4 Normative language - **MUST / MUST NOT** — mandatory; a build that violates it is non-conforming. - **SHOULD** — strongly recommended; deviation must be justified in code comments. - **MAY** — optional. --- ## 2. Overall Description ### 2.1 Current system context (what exists today) - **Backend** (`backend/`): Express + TypeScript, port 3001, JWT access + refresh, `authenticate` + `authorize(role)` middleware, three role-specific user tables, offline-first sync service (`sync_operations`, idempotent via `client_operation_id`), activity logs, device registration, helmet/CORS/compression/rate-limiting, QR label printing pipeline (`qc/qr-jobs`), packing lists, reports/dashboards. Controller files exist in Mongo and MySQL variants (e.g. `batchController.mongo.ts` / `batchController.mysql.ts`) selected by DB config. - **Web frontend** (`frontend/`): pages for Masters, Products, Clients, Vendors, Users, Batches, QC Dashboard/Scan, Dispatch Dashboard/Orders/Scan, PackingList, Reports, Dashboard. - **Mobile** (`mobile/`, `mobile2/`): Expo apps with scanner-driven screens (batches, dispatch orders, scan tab) and offline sync support. - **Existing flow (to be replaced):** production creates batches in `CREATED`; QC scans and records PASS or FAIL (failed batches recorded, reopenable); dispatch orders approved by ADMIN *or* QC; no loading sessions, no live preview, no seal number. ### 2.2 Intentional behaviour changes vs current code | # | Current | Target (this SRS) | |---|---|---| | 1 | Admin manages products/master data | **Unchanged** (FR-01, FR-02) | | 2 | Batch created in `CREATED`; QC later records PASS/FAIL; failed QC batches exist and can be reopened | **QC creates the batch directly in `QC_PASSED`.** The system MUST NOT record failed QC batches anywhere. An `AUTO_PASS` QC record is written for audit only. Endpoints for manual FAIL submit, bulk FAIL submit, and reopen-failed-batch are **removed**. | | 3 | Dispatch order approved by ADMIN or QC | Approval/rejection is a **QC-only** action. Admin has read-only visibility of orders. | | 4 | Packing list viewable on a web page | Dispatch MUST be able to **download** the packing list (PDF/print-ready) for approved orders. | | 5 | Dispatch confirms dispatch per scan; no load tracking | Dispatch **starts a Loading Session**, scans unit QR codes with a live `scanned/total` counter, and Admin sees a **live preview** of every active session (e.g. **10/100**). | | 6 | No seal number, no explicit "not dispatched" outcome | Dispatch **MUST** enter a **seal number** and mark the outcome **DISPATCHED** or **NOT DISPATCHED** (with remarks) to close the session; this updates order, batch, and dispatch-record state. | | 7 | Backend runs in dual DB mode (MySQL or Mongo adapters) | **Single-database mode.** One of MongoDB or MySQL is chosen as the *only* datastore; the other adapter code path is retired. Schema design for both is provided in §6. | ### 2.3 User classes | Role | Platforms | Capability summary | |---|---|---| | ADMIN | Web (+ mobile) | Products & masters, users, live loading monitor, reports/audit. **No order approval.** | | QC | Mobile + web | Create auto-passed batches, print/reprint QR labels, approve/reject dispatch orders. | | DISPATCH | Mobile + web | View QC-passed batches, raise dispatch orders, download packing lists, scan-load with counter, seal & finalise. | --- ## 3. Role Responsibilities (Deliverable 1) ### 3.1 ADMIN — "gatekeeper of master data and all-seeing monitor" 1. **Products:** add/edit/disable products with: name, description, SKU, price, quantity, CAS number, molecular formula, purity, grade, storage conditions, hazard classification, physical state, HSN code, manufacturer. 2. **Masters:** manage clients, vendors, grades, bag quantities, shelf locations (all with active/inactive flags). Grades and bag quantities feed QC's batch-creation dropdowns. 3. **Users:** create/administer QC and DISPATCH accounts (type = `admins` | `qc` | `dispatch`), activate/deactivate, reset passwords. 4. **Monitoring:** - All batches and current inventory state (read). - All dispatch orders and their statuses (read-only — MUST NOT approve/reject). - **Live loading preview:** every active loading session with `scanned/total` (e.g. **10/100**), % progress, last scan event + timestamp, duplicate/wrong-batch warnings; refresh latency ≤ 3 s (polling) or near-real-time (SSE). - Completed sessions: seal number, outcome (DISPATCHED / NOT DISPATCHED), remarks. 5. **Reports & audit:** dashboards, activity logs, QC history (PASS-only), dispatch history. ### 3.2 QC — "creator of good batches and approver of orders" 1. **Batch creation (auto-pass):** create batches against Admin-defined products. The batch MUST be created with status **`QC_PASSED`** and the system MUST simultaneously write one QC audit record (`result = PASS`, `method = AUTO_PASS`, tester = creating QC user). The system MUST NOT provide any UI or API to record a QC FAIL. If material is bad, QC simply does not create the batch (or deactivates/edits it before dispatch) — no failed-QC trace is retained. 2. **Labels:** generate QR print jobs per batch (quantity of unit labels), print and reprint labels. 3. **Batch upkeep:** edit batch details, finish-goods completion, assign shelf location, deactivate. 4. **Dispatch order approval:** review the PENDING queue of dispatch orders; each decision is **Approve** (order → `APPROVED`, batch → `DISPATCH_APPROVED`, packing list frozen) or **Reject** (order → `REJECTED` with remarks, batch returns to `QC_PASSED`). 5. Optionally view QC statistics. ### 3.3 DISPATCH — "hands that move the goods" 1. **View batches:** list of batches with status `QC_PASSED` / `DISPATCH_ORDER_RAISED` (product, quantity, UoM, shelf location). 2. **Raise dispatch order:** pick a batch + client, enter driver name, vehicle number, container number → order `PENDING`; batch → `DISPATCH_ORDER_RAISED`. 3. **Track own orders:** `/mine` list with status (`PENDING`/`APPROVED`/`REJECTED`) and QC remarks. 4. **Download packing list:** for approved orders download/print PDF (client, driver, vehicle, product, batch number, quantity, UoM, shelf location). 5. **Load by scan:** start a Loading Session on an approved order (`total` = order/batch quantity); scan each unit's QR (`scanned` increments); duplicates warned, foreign-batch scans flagged; every scan recorded as an event. 6. **Seal & finalise:** when done enter a non-empty **seal number**, mark the outcome **DISPATCHED** or **NOT DISPATCHED** (+ optional remarks). Session closes; order and batch reach their final status. --- ## 4. Flow (Deliverable 2) ### 4.1 Flow narrative with arrows ``` ADMIN │ adds products (SKU, grade, HSN, hazard, price…) │ maintains clients / vendors / grades / bag quantities / shelf locations / users ▼ Products available as master data ─────────────────────────┐ │ QC │ │ selects product → creates BATCH │ │ (status = QC_PASSED automatically; AUTO_PASS audit row; │ │ NO failed-QC batches are ever recorded) │ │ generates & prints QR labels for the batch │ ▼ │ Batches visible (QC_PASSED) ◄─────────────────────────────────┘ │ DISPATCH │ browses QC_PASSED batches │ picks batch + client + driver + vehicle (+ container) │ ──► raises DISPATCH ORDER (status = PENDING) ▼ QC │ reviews PENDING dispatch orders │ ├── Approve ──► order = APPROVED, batch = DISPATCH_APPROVED, │ │ packing list frozen │ └── Reject ──► order = REJECTED (+ remarks), batch stays QC_PASSED ▼ DISPATCH │ sees APPROVED orders │ downloads / prints PACKING LIST │ starts LOADING SESSION (total = order/batch quantity) │ scans unit QR codes one by one │ scanned count increments ; duplicates & wrong-batch flagged ▼ ADMIN (live, read-only) │ watches loading preview [ scanned / total e.g. 10/100 ] │ progress bar + last-scan feed ▼ DISPATCH │ when all units scanned (or shortfall decided) │ enters SEAL NUMBER (required) │ marks order/batch ──► DISPATCHED or NOT DISPATCHED (+ remarks) ▼ Session closed → batch status final → appears in Admin reports/audit ``` ### 4.2 Flow diagram (Mermaid — renders on GitHub) ```mermaid flowchart TD %% ============ ADMIN LANE ============ subgraph ADMIN["Admin (Web)"] direction TB A_Products["Add / maintain Products
(SKU, grade, HSN, hazard, price)"] A_Masters["Masters: Clients • Vendors • Grades

Functional Requirements, Business Rules & Acceptance Criteria ### 5.1 Products & masters (ADMIN) **FR-01 Products** - Admin MUST be able to create/edit/disable products with all fields listed in §3.1(1). SKU is unique. Non-admin roles have read/search only. - *Accept:* Admin POST `/api/products` returns 201 with saved product; DISPATCH/QC can GET but PUT/DELETE → 403. **FR-02 Masters & users** - Admin manages clients, vendors, grades, bag quantities, shelf locations (active/inactive), and QC/DISPATCH users. Existing `/api/masters`, `/api/clients`, `/api/vendors`, `/api/users`, `/api/shelf-locations` routes remain. - *Accept:* All CRUD flows still work after refactor; inactive masters never appear in QC/DISPATCH dropdowns. ### 5.2 Batch creation auto-pass (QC) **FR-03 Batch auto-pass (core change)** - `POST /api/batches` MUST be authorized to **QC** (already is) and MUST: 1. create the batch with `status = 'QC_PASSED'` (never `CREATED`), 2. write one `qc_records` row: `result='PASS'`, `method='AUTO_PASS'`, `tester_id = `, 3. write an activity log `BATCH_CREATED` (auto-passed). - The system MUST NOT expose any endpoint or UI to record `QC_FAILED`. Retired endpoints: `POST /api/qc`, `POST /api/qc/bulk`, `POST /api/qc/batches/:id/reopen`. - Batch fields: product_id (required), quantity (required > 0), uom, unit_price, manufacturing_date, expiry_date, storage/shelf location, vendor, grade, bag_quantity, notes → batch_number generated per existing `batchNumbers` util; `barcode_value` unique. - *Accept:* - QC creates batch → `GET /api/batches/:id` shows `status: 'QC_PASSED'`; `GET /api/qc/records?batch_id=` shows one `PASS`/`AUTO_PASS` row. - `POST /api/qc` (old submit) → 404/410. - DISPATCH user POST `/api/batches` → 403. - Duplicate `barcode_value` → 409. - No row anywhere contains result `FAIL` (DB constraint: `result ENUM('PASS')` / enum restricted). **FR-04 Labels** - QC creates QR print jobs (`POST /api/qc/qr-jobs`) generating `qr_labels` rows (unique `qr_value`, serial_no per job); list/get/reprint endpoints unchanged. - *Accept:* job with quantity 100 produces 100 label rows; reprint increments print_count; label values unique across the database. ### 5.3 Dispatch orders (DISPATCH raises, QC approves) **FR-05 Batch visibility for DISPATCH** - DISPATCH MUST be able to list batches filtered by `status IN ('QC_PASSED','DISPATCH_ORDER_RAISED')` with product metadata. - *Accept:* batches in `LOADING`/`DISPATCHED`/`NOT_DISPATCHED` never appear in this list. **FR-06 Raise dispatch order** - `POST /api/dispatch-orders` (DISPATCH) with either `batch_id` or `barcode_value` + `client_id`, `driver_name`, `vehicle_number`, `container_number` → creates order `PENDING`, sets batch `DISPATCH_ORDER_RAISED`. - Idempotent via `client_operation_id` (duplicate → 200 + `duplicate:true`, no second order). - *Accept:* order appears in QC's pending queue; batch status changed; retrying the same `client_operation_id` does not create a second order. - *Errors:* batch not in `QC_PASSED`/`DISPATCH_ORDER_RAISED` → 409 `code:'INVALID_BATCH_STATE'`; already has an open order → 409 `code:'OPEN_ORDER_EXISTS'`; unknown barcode → 404. **FR-07 QC approval (core change)** - `POST /api/dispatch-orders/:id/approve` and `.../reject` MUST be `authorize('QC')` **only**. - Approve → order `APPROVED`, `approved_by_id` = QC user, `approved_at` set; batch → `DISPATCH_APPROVED`; packing-list items frozen (snapshot of product/batch/quantity/UoM/location at approval time). - Reject → order `REJECTED` + required `remarks`; batch → back to `QC_PASSED`; if another order is later raised, it repeats the cycle. - *Accept:* ADMIN calling `/approve` → 403; QC approve on non-PENDING order → 409; approved order immediately downloadable (FR-08) with frozen values (later batch edits do not alter the packing list snapshot). **FR-08 Packing list download** - `GET /api/dispatch-orders/:id/packing-list` returns JSON (existing behaviour, now additionally `QC` allowed) and `GET /api/dispatch-orders/:id/packing-list.pdf` returns a print-ready PDF generated server-side — accessible to **QC and DISPATCH** (and ADMIN). - *Accept:* DISPATCH downloads the PDF for an APPROVED order and it contains client, driver, vehicle, container, product, batch number, quantity, UoM, shelf location, frozen at approval. ### 5.4 Loading & live preview (DISPATCH scans, ADMIN watches) **FR-09 Start loading session** - `POST /api/loading-sessions` (DISPATCH, or ADMIN on behalf) `{ dispatch_order_id }` → validates order is `APPROVED`, creates session `ACTIVE` with `total = order/batch quantity` and `scanned = 0`; batch → `LOADING`. - Constraint: **one ACTIVE session per order** and, at any time, one ACTIVE session per batch (409 `SESSION_EXISTS` otherwise). **FR-10 Scan** - `POST /api/loading-sessions/:id/scan` `{ qr_value, client_operation_id }` → resolves the label: - resolves to the session's batch and is first scan of that label → `result:'OK'`, `scanned += 1`; - already scanned in this session → `result:'DUPLICATE'`, counter unchanged; - label belongs to another batch (or unresolvable) → `result:'WRONG_BATCH'`, counter unchanged; - counter MUST NOT exceed `total` (extra OK scans past total → `DUPLICATE`/409 `QTY_EXCEEDED` per choice noted in §6.5). - Every scan appends a `loading_scan_events` row (idempotent on `client_operation_id`). - *Accept:* scanning 10 distinct labels of the right batch on a 100-unit order → `GET /api/loading-sessions/:id` shows `scanned: 10, total: 100`; re-scan → `DUPLICATE`, still 10; foreign label → `WRONG_BATCH`, still 10. **FR-11 Admin live preview (core change)** - `GET /api/loading-sessions/active` (ADMIN — also useful for DISPATCH Supervisor, MAY allow `ADMIN, QC`) returns every ACTIVE session: `{ session_id, order_id, batch, product, loader_name, scanned, total, updated_at, last_event }`. - Readers MUST see changes ≤ 3 s after a scan (2 s polling acceptable; `GET /api/loading-sessions/active/stream` MAY provide SSE with event IDs). - *Accept (the 10/100 demo):* DISPATCH scans 10 units; Admin's monitor page shows `10/100` for that session within 3 s. ### 5.5 Seal & finalise (DISPATCH) **FR-12 Finalise with seal + outcome (core change)** - `POST /api/loading-sessions/:id/finalise` `{ seal_number (required non-empty), outcome: 'DISPATCHED' | 'NOT_DISPATCHED', remarks? }`: 1. session → `CLOSED` with `seal_number`, `outcome`, `completed_at`; 2. order → `CLOSED_DISPATCHED` / `CLOSED_NOT_DISPATCHED`, `seal_number` stored, `dispatched_at` set if DISPATCHED; 3. batch → `DISPATCHED` / `NOT_DISPATCHED`; 4. a `dispatch_records` row written with explicit `dispatched: 1|0`; 5. activity log entries for both seal and outcome. - Finalise with `scanned < total` MUST be allowed but SHOULD require remarks (shortfall explanation); outcome `DISPATCHED` with shortfall SHOULD be flagged as an anomaly in the activity log. - Empty `seal_number` → 400; wrong role → 403; non-ACTIVE session → 409; sequence after close is immutable. - *Accept:* finalise with `outcome:'NOT_DISPATCHED'` → batch shows `NOT_DISPATCHED`; report/dashboard counts update; Admin sees seal number on the completed session. **FR-13 Offline-first & idempotency** - All mobile-scanned writes carry `client_operation_id`; duplicate replays MUST return the original result (`DUPLICATE` status, not an error). Retried orders/scans must never double-increment counters. - *Accept:* replaying the same scan operation twice keeps `scanned` unchanged and returns the first event. **FR-14 Audit trail** - Product edits, batch creation, order raise/approve/reject, session start/finalise, and notable anomalies MUST appear in `activity_logs` with user id/name/role/action/timestamp. ### 5.6 Business rules summary (BR) | BR-ID | Rule | |---|---| | BR-1 | Batch is born `QC_PASSED`; `QC_FAILED` must not exist in the system. | | BR-2 | Only QC approves/rejects dispatch orders. Admin is read-only on orders. | | BR-3 | A batch has at most one open (non-terminal) dispatch order. | | BR-4 | Loading requires an APPROVED order; one ACTIVE session per order (and per batch). | | BR-5 | `scanned` never exceeds `total`; non-OK scans do not increment. | | BR-6 | A session cannot close without a non-empty seal number. | | BR-7 | Outcome is binary: `DISPATCHED` or `NOT_DISPATCHED`; both order and batch reflect it. | | BR-8 | Packing lists are an immutable snapshot taken at approval time. | | BR-9 | All state transitions are role-guarded and logged. | | BR-10 | Every write endpoint is idempotent for mobile clients via `client_operation_id`. | ### 5.7 Non-functional requirements | ID | Requirement | |---|---| | NFR-1 | Security: JWT access+refresh unchanged; helmet, CORS whitelist, rate limits unchanged; all new endpoints role-guarded. | | NFR-2 | Live preview latency ≤ 3 s (poll) / ≤ 1 s (SSE); monitor page handles ≥ 20 concurrent ACTIVE sessions without degradation. | | NFR-3 | Offline-tolerant mobile usage: scans and finalisation queued locally, replayed via sync; conflicts surface as `CONFLICT` with clear codes. | | NFR-4 | All timestamps stored in UTC (ISO-8601 / DATETIME(3)); display localised client-side. | | NFR-5 | Single-database runtime: no dual-mode switch; remove the unused adapter path. | | NFR-6 | Backwards-compatibility helpers: `dispatch_records.dispatched` and `batches.status` mirroring keep existing dashboards functional. | --- ## 6. } → 201 { session:{ id, status:'ACTIVE', total, scanned:0 } } 409 orders must be APPROVED / SESSION_EXISTS POST /api/loading-sessions/:id/scan DISPATCH(, ADMIN) { qr_value, client_operation_id } → 200 { result:'OK'|'DUPLICATE'|'WRONG_BATCH', scanned, total, event_id, duplicate:bool } 409 QTY_EXCEEDED when OK-scan would exceed total 409 session not ACTIVE GET /api/loading-sessions/:id owner(LOADER), QC, ADMIN → { session, events:[last 50] } GET /api/loading-sessions/active ADMIN(, QC) → [ { id, order_id, batch_number, product_name, loader_name, scanned, total, updated_at, last_event:{ result, qr_value, scanned_at } } ] GET /api/loading-sessions/active/stream ADMIN SSE (MAY relocate to polling) POST /api/loading-sessions/:id/finalise DISPATCH(, ADMIN) { seal_number (required), outcome:'DISPATCHED'|'NOT_DISPATCHED', remarks?, client_operation_id? ## Objective
- Fix the ProductScanning web app end-to-end flow to match SRS v2.0: Admin masters → QC creates auto-passed batches → Dispatch requests dispatch order → QC approves → Dispatch downloads packing list → scans/loads with live Admin preview (e.g. 10/100) → enters seal number and marks DISPATCHED / NOT DISPATCHED.
- Make backend changes first, then frontend.

## Requirements
- Admins manage products, clients, vendors, shelf locations, products, bag quantities, grades, users.
- QC creates batches that are automatically QC-passed; no failed-QC batches may ever be recorded.
- Dispatch sees QC-passed batches and requests dispatch orders.
- QC (not Admin) approves/rejects dispatch orders.
- Dispatch sees approved orders and can download packing list after approval.
- Dispatch scans each product to load; live preview visible to Admin (scanned/total).
- Dispatch enters a required seal number, then marks batch DISPATCHED or NOT DISPATCHED.
- Implement backend first, then frontend; move quickly using parallel subagents.

## Decisions
- Active runtime DB is MongoDB (`DB_CLIENT=mongo`), so implementations prioritize the `.mongo.ts` controller path; MySQL wrappers remain compile-compatible but are not the focus.
- Shared contracts (types, schema indexes, server route mount, frontend API/routes/nav) were updated first to allow four disjoint parallel workstreams.
- Batch QR labels continue to be auto-generated during batch creation.
- Packing-list PDF will be generated server-side without adding a new npm dependency.

## Work State
### Completed
- Explored backend/frontend structure, routes, controllers, sync service, schema, and key pages.
- Updated `backend/src/types/index.ts` with new batch/order/loading statuses and loading entities.
- Updated `backend/src/config/database.mongo.ts`: added `loading_sessions` timestamps, loading reference fields (`loader_id`, `scanned_by`, `session_id`).
- Updated `backend/src/config/schema.mongo.ts`: loading collection indexes including partial unique indexes for one ACTIVE session per order and per batch.
- Updated `backend/src/server.ts`: imports and mounts `/api/loading-sessions`.
- Updated `frontend/src/types/index.ts` statuses and loading/order interfaces.
- Updated `frontend/src/services/api.ts`: `batches.list({status})`, dispatch-order raise/reject/approve payloads, `downloadPackingListPdf`, and `loadingSessions` start/scan/get/active/finalise.
- Updated `frontend/src/App.tsx`: added `/loading-monitor`, removed QC scan route (`/qc` redirects to `/batches`), opened packing list to ADMIN/QC/DISPATCH.
- Updated `frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx`: added Live Loading Monitor nav, removed QC Group Scan, renamed DISPATCH scan to “Loading & Scan”, packing list roles expanded.

### Active
- Backend core workflow subagent: batch auto-pass, retire QC fail/reopen endpoints, QC-only order approval/rejection, packing-list freeze + PDF endpoint, sync status/code fixes, dashboard count updates.

- Frontend QC/orders subagent: `Batches.tsx`, `QCDashboard.tsx`, `DispatchOrders.tsx`, `PackingList.tsx`.
- Frontend scan/monitor subagent: `DispatchScan.tsx` rewrite, new `LoadingMonitor.tsx`, `DispatchDashboard.tsx` copy/flow tweaks.

### Blocked
- (none)

1. Wait for the four background subagent completion notifications.
2. Review each subagent’s changed files for correctness and cross-file consistency.

6. Optionally add loading operations to offline sync (`BATCH_CREATE_AUTO_PASS`, `LOADING_SESSION_*`) if mobile parity is expected.

**`frontend/src/pages/DispatchScan.tsx` (rewritten)**

## Objective
- Fix the ProductScanning web app end-to-end flow to match SRS v2.0: Admin masters → QC creates auto-passed batches → Dispatch requests dispatch order → QC approves → Dispatch downloads packing list → scans/loads with live Admin preview (e.g. 10/100) → enters seal number and marks DISPATCHED / NOT DISPATCHED.
- Make backend changes first, then frontend.

## Requirements
- Admins manage products, clients, vendors, shelf locations, products, bag quantities, grades, users.
- QC creates batches that are automatically QC-passed; no failed-QC batches may ever be recorded.
- Dispatch sees QC-passed batches and requests dispatch orders.
- QC (not Admin) approves/rejects dispatch orders.
- Dispatch sees approved orders and can download packing list after approval.
- Dispatch scans each product to load; live preview visible to Admin (scanned/total).
- Dispatch enters a required seal number, then marks batch DISPATCHED or NOT DISPATCHED.
- Implement backend first, then frontend; move quickly using parallel subagents.

## Decisions
- Active runtime DB is MongoDB (`DB_CLIENT=mongo`), so implementations prioritize the `.mongo.ts` controller path; MySQL wrappers remain compile-compatible but are not the focus.
- Shared contracts (types, schema indexes, server route mount, frontend API/routes/nav) were updated first to allow four disjoint parallel workstreams.
- Batch QR labels continue to be auto-generated during batch creation.
- Packing-list PDF will be generated server-side without adding a new npm dependency.
- Legacy production fix/QC-submit endpoints retired (410) rather than kept alive, because SRS v2 has no `CREATED`/`QC_FAILED` states.
- Auto-generated batch numbers now retry with a numeric suffix to avoid same-product/same-day collisions; provided numbers still 409 on duplicate.

## Work State
### Completed
- Shared contract edits: backend/frontend types (new statuses, loading entities), Mongo collections/reference fields/indexes, `/api/loading-sessions` mount, frontend API methods (batch status filter, order raise/approve/reject payloads, PDF download, loading sessions), App routes (`/loading-monitor`, `/qc` redirect), AppLayout nav.
- Backend core subagent: batch auto-pass with `AUTO_PASS` QC records, QC fail/reopen/submit endpoints return 410, QR job creation, QC-only order approve/reject with frozen `packing_list_items`, JSON + PDF packing lists, `PACKING_LIST_STATUSES`, dispatch raise sync errors, dashboard/report status counts, legacy production endpoints retired.
- Backend loading-session subagent: new controller/wrapper/routes for start, scan, detail, active, SSE stream, finalise; scan semantics `OK`/`DUPLICATE`/`WRONG_BATCH`/`QTY_EXCEEDED`; finalise writes dispatch record, closes session/order/batch, deducts stock only when DISPATCHED.
- Frontend QC/orders subagent: `Batches.tsx`, `QCDashboard.tsx`, `DispatchOrders.tsx`, `PackingList.tsx` updated to SRS flow.

  - Offline sync operations `QC_SUBMIT`, `QC_SUBMIT_BULK`, `DISPATCH_CONFIRM`, `DISPATCH_CONFIRM_BULK` now fail with `UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION`, so no stale mobile client can ever write a `QC_FAILED` batch or skip the seal step.
- **Dispatch can resume an in-progress load**
  - `GET /api/loading-sessions/active` now also allows `DISPATCH`, filtered to that user's own sessions. If a dispatcher reloads mid-session, the scan screen can recover it instead of dead-ending on `SESSION_EXISTS`.
